content:
Mathlib has code for docs#HomologicalComplex as well as for bicomplexes via docs#HomologicalComplex₂ from which one defines the totalization.

Is there an analogous library for higher-dimensional complexes, i.e. as the simplest case an n-cube which would be a product of n many 2-term complexes? Such a complex appears e.g. in the construction of Khovanov homology via the resolution of each crossing in a knot diagram into a 2-term complex.
I am not aware of related code.
